status: development after v7a failure, previously inspected cohorts; not independent confirmation
algorithm: For positive target evidence runs of L consecutive valid observations in a stream of n valid observations, support=(L/n)/(L/n+tau). Weight target by support and average; keep original reference/floor; apply original contrast equation. Mix with original uHNDI using eta.
baseline: tau=0 yields unmodified target including non-positive evidence; eta=0 yields original uHNDI
selection: mean inner-fold AUC with ties within 1e-12 prefer original score, smaller eta then smaller tau; no patient-level learned coefficients or fold probability rescaling
shuffle_control: Permute target/evidence pairs inside each contiguous per-stream segment with fixed seed before evaluation; preserve all per-record values and original mean, destroy ordering without bridging gaps
positive_only_control: Weight=1 on positive target evidence, 0 otherwise; same eta grid but no run weighting
binder: Available original seven envelope channels; per-channel late envelope samples reconstructed exactly along published frequency/time positions and averaging offsets. Positive evidence = on-trajectory ITPC greater than same-frequency prestimulus ITPC [-.4,-.3]. Ordered envelope samples are overlapping aggregate measurements, not independent trials or precise neural latency episodes. Original reference/floor retained.
wielek: Target=N1 epoch indicator; positive evidence=N1. Runs never bridge time_record change, time gaps, or other stages. Original R=0 and F=wake+N3 proportions retained. No eye/video annotations or context-missingness features.
mendeley: Chronological clean 4-second theta powers and alpha powers from audited raw block cache. Positive evidence=theta>alpha. Rejected-block gaps break runs. Original alpha mean reference, F=0; no patient exclusions.
metric: mean outer-fold AUC then equal-weight cohort macro AUC, all seeds and adverse outcomes reported
performance_target: positive macro delta over both strong baselines at every seed, positive mean cohort deltas over both, and positive macro mean delta over positive-only and shuffled-order controls
scientific_scope: Explicit low-capacity morphology hypothesis; support does not imply physiological validity or an AUC guarantee. Identity and source/QC checks mandatory. Existing baseline and all negative versions remain preserved. Common feature-gain invariance holds for fixed valid observations and jointly scaled measurement references only.
